free_tier.stated: 2 GB per content file ('Each file must be less than 2 GB. This limit includes cover image files'). An ebook should be at least 4 pages. A supplemental PDF is one per audiobook and must be 'Under 100 MB in size'; an audiobook runs from 5 minutes to 100 hours, and multiple audio parts may be supplied separately or zipped into one file.

egress.terms: Google-served to purchasers; no public hot-link.

interface_detail: Partner Center web upload; also automated content fetching (ONIX/feed) per answer/2763162.
chaining: 2 GB/file with multi-part naming (ISBN_1of3.pdf) means a large work can be split across parts with no stated part count — the sharding is built into the naming convention.
limits_note: per-object-cap 2 GB; PDF/EPUB only for ebooks; PDF unencrypted required; EpubCheck validation required.

identity_cost.detail: a Google Account, or a new account: the checklist says to sign in using a Google Account or create a new account. Publishing then needs a payment profile whose form asks for a business name, contact name, address and phone number, and all publishers must submit tax information. No card is charged at signup.

reliability_note: Payout requires tax/payment setup; publishing is write-gated by Google's review. Ingest is heavily normalised — this is not a byte-preserving store.
